obligations.expected_behavior: The destructive operation declares its affected scope.
forbidden_result: The destructive operation is provided without an affected-scope declaration.
obligations.observable_result: An affected scope is explicitly declared for the destructive operation.
obligations.state_after: The destructive operation has a declared affected scope.
obligations.state_before: A destructive operation is being defined or exposed.
obligations.subject: Destructive operation
obligations.trigger: When a destructive operation is defined or exposed.

obligations.expected_behavior: The destructive operation declares the required confirmation or authorization source.
forbidden_result: The destructive operation does not identify the required confirmation or authorization source.
obligations.observable_result: The required confirmation or authorization source is explicitly declared.
obligations.state_after: The destructive operation has a declared confirmation or authorization source.
obligations.state_before: A destructive operation is being defined or exposed.
obligations.subject: Destructive operation
obligations.trigger: When a destructive operation is defined or exposed.

obligations.expected_behavior: The destructive operation declares either recovery information or an irreversibility disclosure.
forbidden_result: The destructive operation provides neither recovery information nor an irreversibility disclosure.
obligations.observable_result: Recovery or irreversibility information is explicitly disclosed.
obligations.state_after: The destructive operation has a recovery or irreversibility disclosure.
obligations.state_before: A destructive operation is being defined or exposed.
obligations.subject: Destructive operation
obligations.trigger: When a destructive operation is defined or exposed.

obligations.expected_behavior: The system rejects a destructive operation when its affected scope is missing.
forbidden_result: A destructive operation proceeds without an affected-scope declaration.
obligations.observable_result: A missing affected scope causes the operation to fail.
obligations.state_after: The destructive operation is rejected because its affected scope is missing.
obligations.state_before: A destructive operation is requested without a declared affected scope.
obligations.subject: Destructive-operation validation
obligations.trigger: When a destructive operation lacks an affected-scope declaration.

obligations.expected_behavior: The system rejects a destructive operation that uses a bypass flag.
forbidden_result: A bypass flag causes the destructive operation to proceed.
obligations.observable_result: Use of a bypass flag causes the operation to fail.
obligations.state_after: The destructive operation is rejected because a bypass flag was supplied.
obligations.state_before: A destructive operation request includes a bypass flag.
obligations.subject: Destructive-operation validation
obligations.trigger: When a destructive operation request includes a bypass flag.

obligations.expected_behavior: The system rejects confirmation derived solely from untrusted input.
forbidden_result: Confirmation based solely on untrusted input authorizes or permits the destructive operation.
obligations.observable_result: A destructive operation with only untrusted-input confirmation fails.
obligations.state_after: The destructive operation is rejected because its confirmation derives solely from untrusted input.
obligations.state_before: A destructive operation has confirmation derived solely from untrusted input.
obligations.subject: Destructive-operation validation
obligations.trigger: When confirmation for a destructive operation is derived solely from untrusted input.

obligations.expected_behavior: Existing session or user authorization is accepted when the owning policy accepts that authorization.
forbidden_result: A valid existing session or user authorization is rejected solely because it is not a newly issued confirmation.
obligations.observable_result: The operation can proceed using existing session or user authorization when permitted by the owning policy.
obligations.state_after: The existing session or user authorization is accepted under the owning policy.
obligations.state_before: An existing session or user authorization is available and the owning policy accepts it.
obligations.subject: Destructive-operation authorization
obligations.trigger: When an existing session or user authorization is presented and the owning policy accepts it.

obligations.expected_behavior: The operation does not require a redundant confirmation for every destructive operation when an accepted authorization already satisfies the owning policy.
forbidden_result: Every destructive operation is subjected to an additional confirmation despite an already accepted session or user authorization.
obligations.observable_result: No redundant confirmation is requested when the owning policy accepts the existing authorization.
obligations.state_after: The operation proceeds without an unnecessary additional confirmation.
obligations.state_before: An accepted session or user authorization already satisfies the owning policy.
obligations.subject: Destructive-operation confirmation policy
obligations.trigger: When an existing authorization is accepted by the owning policy.
